story_type: stranded man's signal fire spreads, hoist through the smoke
hook: He lit a fire to be found. The wind spread it over an acre.
narration: He lit a signal fire so someone would find him. Then the wind spread it across an acre.
He was stuck on a mountain in the Baboquivari wilderness near Tucson, with a badly broken leg.
A Customs and Border Protection Black Hawk crew flew in with a rescue hoist.
A hoist lets a crew reach someone where a helicopter cannot land. An agent rode the cable down through the smoke.
On the ground, he reached the man and got him ready for the lift.
[short pause] Smoke kept rolling up the slope as the hook came back down.
Then the two of them rose together, hanging over the smoking hillside.
outcome: The crew hoisted him aboard and handed him over to the Three Points Fire Department.
title: His signal fire spread over an acre
description:
A man stranded with a broken leg in the Baboquivari Peak Wilderness near Tucson, Arizona, started a signal fire that the wind spread over an acre. A CBP Air and Marine Operations Black Hawk crew hoisted him out on March 30, 2021.

Footage: U.S. Customs and Border Protection, Air and Marine Operations Tucson Air Branch, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/789159/air-and-marine-operations-rescues-injured-migrant-baboquivari-mountains-march-30-2021
